_what: How the health of each source that feeds a person's automations is read and shown (src/automation-health.mjs, the Workshop tool tool:read-source-health; gathered by src/automations.mjs readHealth, shown on the Automations screen). The periods arrivals are counted over, and which one runs are counted over; each kind of source (carrier: something written elsewhere brought through the one door, src/inbound.mjs; event-source: a connected account's events, src/events.mjs; schedule), with its words and how long it may stay silent before it counts as quiet (null: no silence is expected of it); the carriers always shown, even before anything arrived from them; the words for a source nothing has arrived from and for an arrival that started nothing; which fields of an arrival name it; what each state a run ends in counts as, and which results mean a run worked (it finished, or it started and is still going: a failure before it is over) and which is a failure; errors said in plain words; and the states a source can be in, each with its words, tone and the rules (a formula-engine rule tree over `fields`, operators from parts/formula-engine/rules/rule-operators.json) that put a source in it. The first state whose rules hold is the source's state, so their order matters; a state with rules null holds for every source. Adding a kind of source, a state, a period, a carrier or a plainer error is a row here. A source shows Working only when something really arrived, or a run really finished, inside its kind's working_within_hours; a run still 'working' after stuck_after_hours counts as failed (stuck_words). A carrier that needs a reader (kinds.*.needs_reader) and has none reads 'No reader set up' (idle_words); any other source with no recent arrival reads 'Nothing recent', with idle_words saying since when.

poll_words.missing: {label} is connected but has no next read scheduled.
poll_words.overdue: {label} has missed its next read. Its last arrival does not establish that reading is still running.
poll_words.pending: {count} event(s) from {label} are kept but their rules have not started successfully. They remain queued for retry.
poll_words.gap: {label} stopped accepting its earlier cursor. New items may arrive, but the missed interval has not been reconciled.

reader_words.behind: An item seen on {computer} has not arrived in Trillion yet.
reader_words.stale: {computer} has not reported its reading recently.

The service asked Trillion to slow down. It is tried again later.
